integrity: The proof uses an exact integer carry-state matrix identity and an independent sparse-set/four-input carry cross-check. The embedded scripts reconstruct certificates without remote dependencies. All-depth mathematical conclusions derive from a recurrence, not from finite sampling.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ternary two-sums of positive nondivisibility indices in a cyclic prime-power ring, not sums of the original graph-count values.
The digit-weight cutoff is two; no wider-prime or all-threshold classification is claimed.
Searches and inspected primary texts do not certify historical priority: an unlocated more general digital-convolution formula may subsume the claim.
The 2005/2006 Eu–Liu–Yeh full publication was not accessible for full-text inspection; the graph-count congruence premise was independently confirmed in Gessel’s accessible complete proof.
No independent mathematical audit or external certification has been conducted.
title: Complete ternary two-sum fibers and additive energy of connected-noncrossing-graph nondivisibility indices
